source.title: Portadown News, 26 May 1967, p. 7 ("Killyman's Co. Councillor")
source.publisher: Portadown News (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: name and division from the OCR text of the article, which is clean for these words; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1967: polled 1 June 1967 in two divisions (Newtownhamilton and Bessbrook). The other divisions were returned unopposed, but no list of those members was found except Killyman. Returned unopposed. "Returned unopposed to Armagh County Council for the electoral division of Killyman". He had been a member for ten years; he is the F. H. Hayes returned for Drumcree in 1958-1964, so Killyman may be a new name for that division: not verified. The article calls him hon. treasurer of Killyman Unionist Branch; no label is printed against the return.
